description: Save an Entity of a project as an entity template version: its members (the components bound to it, with the positions, rotations and colours they hold), a description and a picture. `description` is required (20..1000 characters): write it from the Entity's components and its code, in plain words for someone browsing templates: what it is, what it does when the project runs, and how to use it (what to add it to, what it needs). `controls` (optional, at most 200 characters) names its keys or buttons, e.g. "Arrow keys drive, Space brakes". The picture: after the save, any open R3 tab of the account renders the template alone (framed on it, as authored, nothing running) and keeps it as the template's picture. With no R3 tab open the save is kept and the picture is pending: R3 takes it the next time the user opens the Entities Browser. Without templateId it updates the template the Entity was imported from (or makes a new one, under the Entity's id); asNew: true always makes a new template. Updating an existing template needs baseVersion, the version read with r3_entity_read: if the template changed since, nothing is saved and the answer names the current version. The project itself is not changed. The answer lists every reference a member holds to a component outside the Entity (outsideReferences): infrastructure (scene, world, camera, listener, renderer, transport) is expected and re-bound on import; anything else (a geometry or material left outside) is listed first, because an import into another project leaves it empty. The save is not refused for them.

asNew.description: true saves a NEW template, never updating one.

baseVersion.description: The template version you read (r3_entity_read): required to update an existing template.

controls.description: Optional, at most 200 characters: its keys or buttons, e.g. "Arrow keys drive, Space brakes".

description.description: Required, 20..1000 characters, plain words: what it is, what it does when the project runs, how to use it. Written from the Entity's components and code.

entityRef.description: The Entity (its entityRef, or its id).

note.description: What changed, kept with the version.

templateId.description: The template to update (default: the one the Entity came from, else a new one).

name: r3_entity_save_template

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Save an Entity as a template
